```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(data.table)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)
```

```{r echo=TRUE,eval=TRUE}

# Loading data (see fisher_index folder, how to make data) :

header <- colnames(read.table("data.csv", header = TRUE, nrow=1))
data_food<-fread("data.csv",sep=" ",skip=1)
data_food<-setnames(data_food[,-1],header)

# Modify variables in data:

data_food$energy_MJ<-data_food$energy_kcal*0.004184 # energy_kcal variable means summarized purchases calories (kcal) made by customer in each time period.

data_food$energy_adjust_MJ<-(data_food$quantity_sum_category/data_food$energy_MJ)*10

data_food_filt<- data_food %>% filter(!is.infinite(energy_adjust_MJ)) 

data_food_filt<-na.omit(data_food_filt)


#  Convert to data.table for speed/memory

dt <- as.data.table(data_food_filt)

#  Create a wide table:
# - Each household-time is a row, each selected food category gets price & share columns

dt_wide <- dcast(
  dt, 
  customer_id + elapsed_time  ~ food_categ, 
  value.var = c("fisher_index","energy_adjust_MJ"),
  fill = 0
)

names(dt_wide)

# Price elasticity to relative volumes:

#  SETUP 

rm(data_food)
rm(dt)
gc()

categories      <- levels(data_food_filt$food_categ)
energy_vars     <- paste0("energy_adjust_MJ_", categories)
fisher_names    <- paste0("fisher_index_", categories)
price_vars      <- paste0("log(", fisher_names, ")")
fe_string       <- "factor(customer_id) + factor(elapsed_time)"


# fepois  
fepois_list <- lapply(seq_along(categories), function(i){
  outcome <- energy_vars[i]
  formula_str <- paste0(outcome, " ~ ", paste(price_vars, collapse = " + "), " | ", fe_string)
  fepois(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = dt_wide,
    cluster = ~customer_id,
    fixef.rm = "none"
 )
})
names(fepois_list) <- categories


extract_coef_se_table <- function(model_list, categories, price_vars) {

  n <- length(categories)

  coef_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)
  se_mat   <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n)

  rownames(coef_mat) <- colnames(coef_mat) <- categories
  rownames(se_mat)   <- colnames(se_mat)   <- categories

  for (i in seq_along(categories)) {

    m  <- model_list[[i]]
    ct <- coeftable(m)

    for (j in seq_along(categories)) {

      vname <- price_vars[j]

      if (vname %in% rownames(ct)) {
        coef_mat[i, j] <- ct[vname, "Estimate"]
        se_mat[i, j]   <- ct[vname, "Std. Error"]
      }
    }
  }

  list(coef = coef_mat, se = se_mat)
}



coef_se <- extract_coef_se_table(
  fepois_list,
  categories,
  price_vars
)

coef_mat <- round(coef_se$coef,2)
se_mat   <- round(coef_se$se,3)

coef_se_table <- ifelse(
  is.na(coef_mat),
  "",
  paste0(
    coef_mat,
    " (",
    se_mat,
    ")"
  )
)

coef_se_table

```
